plotEn:
In the late 1990s, middle schoolers Sean, Aimee, Crosby, Ted and Charmaine form a tight-knit group of friends known as the "Matchbox Gang" in Cartersville, Ohio, bonded by their shared childhood interest in Matchbox cars. Although Sean harbors a crush on Aimee, the group eventually drifts into adulthood along separate paths. Years later, Aimee works as a motor-racing paramedic, Crosby is a construction foreman married to Charmaine, now a newscopter pilot, and Ted works as a high school science teacher. Unlike his friends who lead quiet lives in their hometown, Sean serves as a globe-trotting CIA operative.
One day, Smalley, a mechanic at the auto repair shop and Aimee’s uncle, passes away, prompting Sean to return to his hometown after 28 years and reunite with Aimee, Crosby, Ted, and Charmaine. Unexpectedly, the incoming CIA Director, Mosier, kidnapped the five individuals, suspecting that Sean had stolen a nuclear warhead intended for a CIA ally. Sean rescued the group, fitted Mosier and the others with parachutes before pushing them out of the plane, and then landed the aircraft in Casablanca. 
Subsequently, Sean discovers that his trusted CIA contact, Helen, along with several other associates, have gone rogue. They have stolen the nuclear warhead and intend to detonate it at a peace summit in Budapest, aiming to incite the United States to engage in further foreign conflicts. Aimee, Crosby, Ted, and Charmaine have been framed by the CIA and are now wanted fugitives; Sean
